Sift & Shift v10

Flatten the solar system, one layer at a time.

Sift & Shift v10

Contract 1 · The Moon · Map n is n² layers deep, plus 2% more per map (map 50 is twice as deep). The board starts at 10×10 and can grow.

Tech Testing

Plane Estates' product trials. A trial pauses your contract and starts a fresh dig at map 1 with your research and contract strength, an empty wallet, and the trial's crew rules. You have the morning: four game hours until lunch (the Office's lunch table adds more). Passing tier 5 and tier 10 also puts a prototype on show in the Office lobby, for good. Reach the trial's next tier map before then to pass it, and passing a tier opens the next one. Each trial has ten tiers (one more opens every 10 contracts) and only your best counts toward its permanent boost. Leave whenever you like and your contract carries on exactly where it was. The chips show how long each tier took the first time, and on which contract.

Menu

for this save; it goes on the log files from now on.
admin: new daily reports and off-the-record notes don't pop up over the panel; they still collect in the Reports tab with its count.
test layout: Money, Map, Layers and the rest as a column beside the board instead of a bar across the top.
a short note and Steve's explanation the first time something new turns up, once per save. Turning them off still marks them seen; "show them all again" clears this save's list.
admin speed test: the game keeps running and the numbers keep updating, but the board (2D or 3D) isn't drawn. Not saved: it's back on next time the game opens.
no pop-up for an achievement this save has earned in an earlier run. It still counts, and new ones still show.
a save you load (or a new game) opens paused, so you can set things up first. Space bar pauses and resumes any time.
saves a code each time you sign one: in the Windows player straight into the saves folder; in a browser as a download (it may ask once to allow several)
Music rotation

Tick the tracks you want in the rotation while you play. At least one stays on. The contract-complete card and the orientation tape keep their own tunes.

The Office

The whole game as a code (the Office included). Copy it, or save it as a file.
